name: lexicon
description: Document-mediated workflow for coding agents. Keeps human and agent aligned on a shared mental model via a small cold-layer doc (vocabulary, invariants, bounded contexts, design system) and a per-session loop of grounding, retro, and crystallization. Inspired by domain-driven design's ubiquitous language; extends the same discipline to design vocabulary on UI projects. Ships as one skill with six subcommands (adopt / ground / retro / crystallize / conform / evolve) exposed as plugin-namespaced slash commands.
